title: The Resurgent Structure of Quantum Knot Invariants
note: arXiv:2007.10190. Complete resurgent structure of the Chern–Simons / Kashaev asymptotic series for hyperbolic knot complements, worked in detail for $4_1$ and $5_2$: location of Borel singularities at the complex-volume lattice and Stokes constants organised as integer $q$-series identified with the 3d-index / DGG state-integral data. For QOU this is the derivation-side target for the odd-face Stokes constant $A_\omega$ (monodromy-datum gap G3): a Stokes constant that is an integer count is a derived quantity, not a fit. Companion to the trivial-flat-connection sequel arXiv:2111.04763.
